title: Kể chuyện: had been doing và các thì quá khứ
summary: Kể chuyện mạch lạc bằng quá khứ đơn, quá khứ tiếp diễn, quá khứ hoàn thành và quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn.

dialogue.en: Why were you so wet when you came in?
dialogue.vi: Sao lúc vào bạn ướt thế?

dialogue.en: I [[had been waiting]] for a bus for half an hour.
dialogue.vi: Mình đã đứng chờ xe buýt nửa tiếng rồi.

dialogue.en: Yes. It [[was raining]] hard and I [[had forgotten]] my umbrella.
dialogue.vi: Ừ. Trời đang mưa to mà mình lại quên ô.

dialogue.en: Did the bus come in the end?
dialogue.vi: Cuối cùng xe có đến không?

dialogue.en: No. It [[had broken]] down, so I [[walked]] here.
dialogue.vi: Không. Xe bị hỏng nên mình đi bộ đến đây.

sections.heading: Mỗi thì một việc
sections.rule: **Quá khứ đơn**: các sự việc chính. **Quá khứ tiếp diễn**: bối cảnh đang diễn ra. **Quá khứ hoàn thành**: việc xảy ra trước. **Quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn**: việc kéo dài đến trước đó.

head: Thì
Dùng để
rows: sự việc chính, theo thứ tự
I had been waiting for an hour.

examples.vi: Khi chúng tôi đến thì trời đang nắng.
examples.why: Bối cảnh (was shining) + sự việc chính (arrived).

examples.en: She [[had lost]] her keys, so she [[called]] me.
examples.vi: Cô ấy làm mất chìa khóa nên gọi cho tôi.
examples.why: Mất chìa xảy ra trước → had lost.

check.prompt: We ___ dinner when the lights went out.
check.explain: Việc đang diễn ra thì bị cắt ngang → quá khứ tiếp diễn.

sections.heading: Quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn
sections.rule: **had been + V-ing**: một việc **kéo dài** trước một mốc quá khứ, thường để giải thích **kết quả nhìn thấy** lúc đó.
body: So sánh: *I had read the book* (đọc xong) và *I had been reading for hours* (đọc kéo dài, nhấn quá trình).

examples.en: His eyes were red. He [[had been crying]].
examples.vi: Mắt cậu ấy đỏ. Cậu ấy đã khóc.
examples.why: Kết quả nhìn thấy (mắt đỏ) ← việc kéo dài trước đó.

examples.en: We [[had been driving]] for hours when the car stopped.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi lái xe hàng giờ thì xe chết máy.
examples.why: Kéo dài đến mốc xe dừng.

examples.en: She was tired because she [[had been working]] all day.
examples.vi: Cô ấy mệt vì đã làm việc cả ngày.
examples.why: Giải thích nguyên nhân bằng quá trình kéo dài.

check.prompt: The ground was wet. It ___ all night.
check.explain: Kết quả lúc đó (đất ướt) ← mưa kéo dài trước → had been raining.

sections.heading: Had done hay had been doing?
sections.rule: **had done** nhấn việc **đã xong** hoặc **số lượng**; **had been doing** nhấn **quá trình, thời lượng**.

examples.en: I [[had written]] three emails by ten.
examples.vi: Đến mười giờ tôi đã viết xong ba email.
examples.why: Có số lượng (three emails) → had written.

examples.en: I [[had been writing]] emails all morning.
examples.vi: Tôi đã viết email cả buổi sáng.
examples.why: Nhấn thời lượng → had been writing.

check.explain: Có số lượng (five reports) → had written.

mistakes.wrong: I was tired because I was working all day.
mistakes.right: I was tired because I had been working all day.
mistakes.why: Việc kéo dài trước mốc quá khứ → had been working.

mistakes.wrong: When I arrived, she cooked, so the kitchen smelled great.
mistakes.right: When I arrived, she was cooking, so the kitchen smelled great.
mistakes.why: Đang diễn ra lúc tôi đến → was cooking.

mistakes.wrong: He had been writing four books by 2010.
mistakes.right: He had written four books by 2010.
mistakes.why: Có số lượng → had written, không dùng dạng tiếp diễn.

mistakes.wrong: We had been waited for an hour.
mistakes.right: We had been waiting for an hour.

mistakes.wrong: It rained, so the roads were wet when we left.
mistakes.right: It had been raining, so the roads were wet when we left.
mistakes.why: Mưa kéo dài trước, để lại kết quả → had been raining.

exercises.prompt: She was out of breath because she ___.
exercises.explain: Kết quả lúc đó ← việc kéo dài trước → had been running.

exercises.prompt: While I ___ TV, someone knocked on the door.
exercises.explain: Bối cảnh đang diễn ra → was watching.

exercises.prompt: By the time the police came, the thieves ___.
exercises.explain: Việc xong trước mốc → had escaped.

exercises.prompt: How long ___ you been waiting when the train came?
exercises.explain: Thời lượng đến mốc quá khứ → had been waiting.

exercises.prompt: Câu nào nhấn quá trình kéo dài?
options: I had been cleaning the house.
exercises.explain: Had been cleaning nhấn quá trình.

exercises.prompt: Her hands were dirty. She ___ in the garden.
exercises.explain: Kết quả nhìn thấy ← việc kéo dài → had been working.

exercises.prompt: We ___ along the beach when it started to rain.
exercises.explain: Đang diễn ra thì bị cắt ngang → were walking.

exercises.prompt: I couldn't get in because I ___ my keys.
They had been ___ for two hours before they found the hotel.

exercises.vi: Cô ấy mệt vì đã học cả đêm.
exercises.explain: Had been studying giải thích nguyên nhân.

exercises.vi: Khi tôi đến thì họ đang ăn tối.
alternatives: When I arrived they were having dinner.
exercises.explain: Bối cảnh → quá khứ tiếp diễn.

exercises.sentence: He was angry because he waited for two hours.
answers: He was angry because he had been waiting for two hours.
exercises.explain: Kéo dài trước mốc → had been waiting.

exercises.sentence: When I got home, my brother had been eating all the cake.
answers: When I got home, my brother had eaten all the cake.
exercises.explain: Ăn hết (kết quả trọn vẹn) → had eaten.

exercises.sentence: While she cooked, the phone rang.
answers: While she was cooking, the phone rang.
exercises.explain: Bối cảnh đang diễn ra → was cooking.

exercises.vi: Mắt anh ấy đỏ vì anh ấy đã khóc.
answers: His eyes were red because he had been crying.
His eyes were red because he'd been crying.
His eyes were red because he had cried.
exercises.explain: Kết quả lúc đó ← việc kéo dài → had been crying.

exercises.vi: Chúng tôi đã chờ một tiếng thì xe buýt đến.
answers: We had been waiting for an hour when the bus came.
We had been waiting for an hour when the bus arrived.
We'd been waiting for an hour when the bus came.
We'd been waiting for an hour when the bus arrived.
We had waited for an hour when the bus came.
We had waited for an hour when the bus arrived.
exercises.explain: Thời lượng đến mốc → had been waiting.
